briefings.title: U.S., Iran close to ending war? Iran war's impact on the midterms

people.name: Mick Mulvaney

briefings.tldr: The ongoing conflict with Iran and sustained high energy prices present significant political risks for incumbents ahead of the midterms, while the domestic debate shifts toward "Gilded Age" inequality and the role of state intervention in the economy.
